paragraphs.text: Joel Pedraza Villaseñor participated in Seizure PRS-11-01 on 2011-05-12. Círculo del Valle Quieto was linked to Seizure PRS-11-01 on 2011-05-12. Seizure PRS-11-01 occurred at Presidio on 2011-05-12. Liaison reporting from a contact in Ensenada with family in the Chihuahua trucking trade described the seizure of 1,100 kg of cannabis at the Presidio port of entry from the tractor-trailer the crews call Tráiler Sierra Madre Doce. The contact attributed the load to Pedraza, the Reynosa plaza boss for Círculo del Valle Quieto known as El Diez, who had reportedly been using the Ojinaga crossing to avoid attention on the Tamaulipas bridges.

Autotransportes Sierra Madre Norte supported Seizure PRS-11-01 on 2011-05-12. Tráiler Sierra Madre Doce was involved in Seizure PRS-11-01 on 2011-05-12. Joel Pedraza Villaseñor used DEMO-TEL-00003 on 2011-05-12. The contact stated that the unit was running under the trucking firm's paperwork with a declared load of ceramic tile and that the cannabis was found behind a false front wall. The telephone identifier above was the one the driver was instructed to call on arrival. The contact did not know whether the driver was arrested.

Seizure PRS-11-01 transited Ojinaga crossing on 2011-05-12. Aurelio Castañón Vidaurri led Círculo del Valle Quieto from 2010-09-01 until 2019-05-23. Joel Pedraza Villaseñor was a member of Círculo del Valle Quieto from 2010-09-01 until 2020-01-10. The contact characterized Castañón as the head of the network and Pedraza as a founding member who was given the Ojinaga crossing to test after friction with the Reynosa crew. The reporting office assesses the contact as having secondhand access through family. The quantity reported is the figure the contact was given and has not been verified against the seizure record.
